name: Summer at Park
description_short: An ACA-accredited day camp for kids PreK through 10th grade (ages 4-15) on The Park School's 34-acre campus in Brookline, with over 35 general and specialty programs including art, science, cooking, leadership, outdoor adventures, sports and general day camps. It offers one- and two-week sessions, extended day and a shuttle bus from Brookline Village, and some programs visit places in and around Boston.

warnings: This is The Park School's overview page for its summer programs, not a page for one camp. It describes two separate camps and a family swim club. This listing covers only Summer at Park.

Creative Arts at Park (CAAP) is a separate camp described on the same page: an arts camp for ages 7-15 where campers build their own schedules from visual arts, dance, theater, music, video/film, computers, photography, creative writing, martial arts and sports. It should get its own listing.
Swim Club at Park is a family pool membership for evenings and weekends, not a camp.
The address and phone number are The Park School's main contact details from the page footer. They may not reach the camp office directly.
No season year, dates or prices are given, so season_year is left blank. The website URL is the overview page. The camp's own 'Find Out More' page is not given.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
